comparisonRequirements: Pin both source revisions, dependencies, hardware and thread/GPU configuration
Choose a common geological task and supported feature set; equal seeds do not imply equal geology across generators
Match spatial extent, spacing, node/cell convention, depth axis, precision, output properties and output completeness
Do not compare the coarse viewer grid with 10m full-volume generation
Record recipe construction, model evaluation, sampling, serialization and export separately; never time only a cached model or viewer frames
One warmup and at least three isolated trials on the same hardware tier, record every trial and peak-memory measurement scope
Use fixed public synthetic tasks and development data to freeze methods; keep independent field holdouts separate
Report unsupported geology and failures, all changes to settings, resampling, smoothing and any accuracy/performance tradeoffs
For a downstream FWI claim, fix solver/acquisition/architecture/training budget and split by whole model/geological family; prevent slice/seed leakage
A different GPU hardware result can be a cost/availability comparison, not an unqualified algorithm speedup
